features.name: New skill: pr-preflight (PR-landscape gate before gh pr create)
features.notes: Built 2026-04-16 at ~/.claude/skills/pr-preflight/ after user flagged that PRs were being created with zero awareness of overlapping open PRs on shared files (sidebar, types, permissions). Wired into /ship-myjkkn step 6a and /myjkkn-chain diagram. Exit codes 0/1/2 drive automation.
